## Findings checked and refused

- **čeriġüd = čerig + linking -ü- + -d** (U1): the house glossary has the same analysis; kept.
- **(i) in γažar(i)-jar, γažar-tur(i)-jan** (U28, U42, U53): kept as linking/Shiratori's (a dative cannot also be accusative); only the object cases were hedged (#31).
- **bitun / bitužu** (U2, U28): drafter's reading accepted (沼 beside 沿 at §152, the same stem; a misprint is likely). Hedged in note; l/i unchanged.
- **eje-dür** (U36): "counsel" accepted; house glossary has eje-dür(i)-jen 'in one's own counsel'.
- **Wang Qan as subject/object**: U0 (agent in the dative -daγan: Wang Qan is the killer), U22 (nasutu-ji accusative: Wang Qan is the one carried off), U45 (Qān-a agent of the passive) all hold; kept.
- **nögör** (U53): 'foe' read from Ming 被敵, hedged in note and morph; kept.
- **nödübe-kü** (U20): see #10; l kept "pounded".
- **qaliγ̇un** (U30): see #27.
- **težiġebe 'reared' (l) / 'fed' (i)** (U9, U31): the glossary has both; kept.
- **U40 passive i** ("They were brought"): kept, the agent is named in U41; note now says so.
- **U63 "take back"**: kept; implied by the sense, and l gives the literal.
- **tebčin** (U37): not split; the house glossary leaves it unanalysed.
- **Packet oddity**: 389 shows 圓 for 圖 (ügeš-tür); source, left.

## Follow-up for pass 2 / glosser
- Shared glossary has `darun` under dara- (Ming 壓); this part's lemma is now daru- (daruγ̇asu, darun, daružu). Broaden or harmonise.
- `qaγ̇ulžu` (known: 'rush', Ming 奔着) needs a broadening for 'break, rout' (Ming 破着).
- `dužu` known entry fits saγ̇al-dužu; `saγ̇al` needs a new entry ('-l-' of the reciprocal).
- `ügüledügsen` lacks the l of -ldü- in Shiratori's print.

major 1 · moderate 16 · minor 21 · trivial 5 (43 entries; #2 and #3 are grouped entries covering many units).

# Review, pass 2 — secret-history-151-153

Reviewer checked every entry of `gloss.json` (129 novel + 7 `__broaden__`) against the packet's Ming gloss (all 129 bracketed glosses match the packet exactly), the units' morph lemmas and glosses, the shared glossary and the house spellings. Coverage: all 305 reader tokens of `t` have an entry (129 novel, 7 broadened, the rest already in the shared glossary); no unused keys; every entry matches "<form> — <meaning> (<grammar>) [<Ming>]" (bitun and aγ̇ur reshaped). `t` untouched (64 units, 408 words). Modern translations not opened. No build, no publish.

## Checked and refused

- **Pass-1 follow-up on `dužu`/`saγ̇al`**: kept the two-token split (saγ̇al- + dužu); there is no way to merge them.
- **`bariγ̇as` 'shackles'**: kept; Ming 刑禁 (penal restraint) allows it, the entry and morph already hedge the link with bari-.
- **`jorči-`, `horγu-`, `qana-`, `turu-`, `öles-`**: stems inferred from the Ming and marked so; kept.
- **`kikün`**: kept as ki- + -kün; the entry already says 飮 only writes the sound.
- **`qubijaldud-že` (-d 'first-person hortative')**: guess, already marked uncertain; no better analysis from the Ming 共分 也者.
- **Čiṅgis "title borne by Temüjin from 1206"**: outside knowledge but matches the shared glossary; left.
- **Shared entries** other than the broadened ones: checked the Ming bracket of every shared token against this part's packet; all fit except darun, qaγ̇ulžu, dužu, aduγ̇un (now broadened).
